=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py
Line or code reference: 474
Problem: build_autofix_failure_payload constructs comments_excerpt with sanitize_text("\n\n---\n\n".join(comment_texts[-8:]), COMMENTS_EXCERPT_LIMIT) — prefix truncation of chronologically-joined comments.
Why it fails at runtime: On a PR with a large orchestrator-state comment followed by a harness-diagnostic comment, the chronologically-joined string places the state blob at the front. sanitize_text drops the trailing diagnostic because the state blob already consumed the COMMENTS_EXCERPT_LIMIT budget. The intake receives an excerpt with no harness diagnosis, cannot determine what failed, and opens an inconclusive heal issue — exactly the symptom the linked issue #4325 describes.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "In workflow_failure_heal.py::build_issue_payload, build bounded excerpts newest-first and compact or omit bulky orchestrator-state blobs so recent failure comments survive." (Suggested fix item 1) — the same bug pattern must be fixed in build_autofix_failure_payload, which is a sibling function with identical comment-processing logic.
Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:474 replaces sanitize_text with _build_recent_comments_excerpt.
Evidence of absence: Line 474 still reads "comments_excerpt": sanitize_text("\n\n---\n\n".join(comment_texts[-8:]), COMMENTS_EXCERPT_LIMIT). _build_recent_comments_excerpt exists at line 296, is used by build_issue_payload at line 371, but is not called from build_autofix_failure_payload.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Add regression coverage using a large state comment followed by a harness-error comment, asserting both the diagnosis and run reference reach the payload." (Suggested fix item 4) — coverage must exist for the autofix failure path too, not just build_issue_payload.
Expected change site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py near _autofix_payload (line 1169) and test_autofix_payload_validates_and_fingerprints_by_reason (line 1187).
Evidence of absence: No test constructs a build_autofix_failure_payload with a large ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2 comment in comment_texts followed by a harness-diagnostic comment and asserts that (a) the diagnostic text survives in comments_excerpt, (b) the ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2 blob is compacted to the placeholder, and (c) the total excerpt length is bounded by COMMENTS_EXCERPT_LIMIT. The existing build_issue_payload test at line 263 covers the analogous issue-payload path, but no autofix-payload equivalent exists.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

Problem: `build_autofix_failure_payload` still builds `comments_excerpt` with `sanitize_text("\n\n---\n\n".join(comment_texts[-8:]), COMMENTS_EXCERPT_LIMIT)` — the old prefix-truncation pattern — instead of routing through `_build_recent_comments_excerpt` (defined at line 296, used by `build_issue_payload` at line 371).
